sn40.2:1.4: idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn40.2:1.6: so khvāhaṃ āvuso vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn40.2:1.7: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato vitakkasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.
sn40.2:2.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn40.2:2.3: mā brāhmaṇa dutiyajjhānaṃ pamādo dutiyajjhāne cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi dutiyajjhāne cittaṃ ekodiṃ karohi dutiyajjhāne cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn40.2:2.4: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ.
sn40.2:2.5: yaṃ hi taṃ āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn40.2:2.6: satthārānuggahito sāvako mahābhiññataṃ pattoti. mamaṃ taṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
